fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant reported that a shop near Vaigai Layout Market Road was occupied without a valid agreement and the occupant refused to leave. The matter was brought to Tiruppur North PS on 2026-08-03, while the incident was placed on 2026-07-28 around 14:20 hrs. The complainant, Vasanth Chandran, provided the contact number 9000000408. A person named Anand Palanisamy, associated with the number 9000000093, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. A witness, Kavitha Selvam, reachable on 9000000099, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned physical documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00466, as the mobile number 9000000093 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Occupant reportedly refused to vacate despite repeated requests.
